evidence_excerpt: launched three digital initiatives ... intelligent rooms that tunes itself to the preferences of the guest through machine learning and Artificial Intelligence
evidence_summary: Emaar Hospitality Group announced an organization-wide digital-transformation program in April 2018 including an intelligent-room initiative using ML/AI.
source_locator: Official Emaar release, 22 Apr 2018 > A focus on digitisation
adoption_interpretation: Kept below deployment threshold because the release describes launched initiatives/projects but does not demonstrate that the intelligent-room AI system was already operating in production. This is pre-adoption/early-initiative evidence, not a treatment date.
notes: Do not infer operational adoption from 'launched three digital initiatives' without a production use statement.

evidence_excerpt: signed a Memorandum of Understanding ... to launch ‘Emaar Smart Home’
evidence_summary: Emaar announced a Xiaomi partnership for AI-powered smart homes scheduled to launch in 2020.
adoption_interpretation: MoU / announced rollout is not sufficient evidence of production deployment under the frozen codebook.
notes: The source uses future language ('will launch', 'will be made available'); score 1 prevents a false treatment date.

evidence_excerpt: successfully completed the installation of the Winnow system in five of its premier properties in 2023
evidence_summary: Emaar Hospitality reports operational installation of an AI-enabled food-waste system in five hotels. Cameras identify and record wasted items and the system learns from captured images.
source_locator: Emaar Sustainability > Harnessing AI for Sustainability at Emaar Hospitality
adoption_interpretation: First observed unambiguous operational AI deployment in the currently audited Emaar record. Earlier 2018/2020 items remain below threshold; additional 2021-2022 searches are still required before a definitive first-adoption year is frozen.
notes: Concrete installed AI/computer-vision system qualifies as deployed. Score 2 rather than 3 because food-waste management is an operating-support function rather than the core property-development decision process.

evidence_excerpt: Emaar is deploying advanced AI systems to analyse and predict the future needs of retailers and visitors
evidence_summary: Emaar's February 2024 Dubai Square announcement states that advanced AI systems are being deployed to analyze and predict retailer and visitor needs.
adoption_interpretation: Supports persistence/deepening after the 2023 installed system but is not used to backdate adoption.
notes: The project itself is under development, so score 2 is conservative despite explicit 'deploying' language.
